verdict.rationale: Firestore docs state that it caches actively used data so the app can write, read, listen to, and query even while the device is offline. They also say it keeps data in sync across clients through realtime listeners and offers offline support for mobile and web, which covers the core of offline-capable clients with syncing writes. missing for 10: explicit documentation that queued local writes are pushed automatically on reconnect (implied rather than stated), conflict-resolution/consistency details for offline writes, independent or hands-on corroboration of offline sync behavior.
